observation_boundary: Shared group-event packing applied to firing-density proxy; not a validated HFO/LFP forward model. No causal-family masking or K=2 filtering.
loss: Joint sliced Wasserstein on four equally scaled blocks: contact participation, participating-only rank, relative timing, rank-weighted spatial moments. No fitted PCA or direction/core-axis penalty.
adaptation: Each round saves results and diagnosis; random restarts and local radii adapt, while patient target, observation definition and loss stay locked. Eight unsuccessful rounds request model-capacity audit, never silently relax acceptance.
claims: One-patient development working point; no uniqueness, anatomical-core localization, clinical seizure or formal equilibrium bifurcation claim. Sequential confirmation attempts are logged and are not a single untouched validation experiment.
